Ivy: Cheddar discovered the parking-lot puddle and declared it a spa. Photo: https://i.imgur.com/7kQpLzH.jpg :joy:
Marcus: Full belly-flop. He9s very committed. :rofl: :paw_prints:
Talia: That leaf stuck to his ear is peak drama. :fallen_leaf: :crown:
Sam: Is he okay? Need a towel? :sweat_smile:
Zoe: I have a towel in my bag and some training treats. On my way. :running_woman: :towel:

Marcus: Can we make a formal Cheddar break at the 3pm standup? Morale will spike. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Talia: Vote: Cheddar = Office Morale Officer. React with thumbs up or thumbs down.
Sam: +1 and a treat budget.
lunchbot: Lunch poll — "Pup-themed cookies?" yes: 9 no: 2
Zoe: Quick pet photoshoot in the kitchen in ~10? Bring treats and non-squeaky toys. :camera_with_flash:
Ivy: Cheddar is now a tiny towel burrito and judging my outfit choices. Thanks Zoe! :heart:
Marcus: Routing this straight to my "cute photos" folder in the brain. Will subpoena more pics later. :camera_with_flash:
Talia: Next time bring a leaf crown, he nails medieval vibes. :crown: :fallen_leaf:
